csv_row.description: UK Protection Specialist for life insurance, critical illness, income protection, and trust planning. Conducts needs analysis calculating sum assured for income replacement and debt coverage, compares provider policies and definitions, navigates underwriting and medical disclosure, and recommends discretionary or absolute trust structures. Use for protection needs calculations, comparing life insurance quotes, selecting critical illness definitions, advising on income protection waiting and benefit periods, keyman insurance, or setting up trusts for policies.
